name: dumbbell seated on exercise ball shoulder press
description: An overhead press on a stability ball. The unstable seat makes your core work along with the shoulders.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet wide and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
